descriptor: Aerospace-minded product company hiring in Bristol

voice.summary: A hiring manager who respects your time: friendly, specific and never gushing. It explains what happens next and treats a draft saved as a small act of care.
dos: Tell applicants what happens next and when
Describe the role and the hybrid setup plainly
Use warm confirmations with a reference number
donts: Blaming the applicant for form errors

taglines: Help us design what comes next
Bring your craft, we bring the problems
boilerplate: Orbital Systems is a Bristol-based product company hiring a Senior Product Designer in a hybrid role, with a short application that saves drafts automatically.
